description: Weather and electric load dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Manvi Mishra. The present dataset combines the details of hourly load variation with the hourly weather parameters. The load dataset has been obtained from one of the substations (location Ahmedabad) and weather parameters dataset has been extracted from the NASA open-source website. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
